item.title: Assam Launches Statewide SVEEP Drive to Boost Voter Awareness Ahead of April 9 Polls
item.description: A variety of outreach programmes have been organised to engage voters, including street plays, drawing and rangoli competitions, slogan writing, digital poster-making contests, wall art, workshops, and news presentation competitions.

item.title: At Least 66 Dead in Columbian Air Force Plane Crash
item.description: At least 66 killed after a Colombian Air Force C-130 plane crashed shortly after takeoff in Putumayo, raising concerns over military aircraft safety.

item.title: ECI Appoints Special Observer for April 9 Assam Polls
item.description: Officials said he will be available to receive concerns and representations from political parties, social organisations, and the general public. He can be contacted daily between 11 am and 5 pm for election-related issues.

item.title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Key Russian Oil Export Hub at Primorsk, Fires Reported
item.description: Primorsk is a critical hub for Russia’s flagship Urals crude and premium diesel exports, with a capacity exceeding 1 million barrels of crude and around 300,000 barrels of diesel per day.

item.title: Assam Elections 2026: Congress Debutante Bidisha Neog Challenges Himanta Biswa Sarma in Jalukbari Fortress
item.description: Congress debutante Bidisha Neog challenges Himanta Biswa Sarma in Jalukbari, raising corruption, civic and environmental issues ahead of polls.

item.title: Only Hindus, Buddhists and Sikhs Can Claim Scheduled Caste Status: Supreme Court
item.description: “No person professing a religion other than Hindu, Sikh or Buddhist can be considered a member of a Scheduled Caste. Conversion to another religion leads to the loss of such status,” the Bench stated.

item.title: Centre Tightens Surveillance as Generic Weight Loss Drugs Hit Indian Markets
item.description: India tightens surveillance on GLP-1 weight-loss drugs as generic semaglutide hits market, warning against misuse and unauthorised sales.

item.title: BCCI Introduces Strict Guidelines for IPL 2026: No Match-Day Practice; Family Members, Friends to Travel Separately
item.description: To maintain broadcast standards and avoid distractions, players and support staff have been barred from sitting directly in front of LED advertising boards during matches.

item.title: “Maybe Me and the Ayatollah”: Trump on Who Will Control the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Trump says Strait of Hormuz will “be open very soon” and hints at joint control with Iran amid ongoing Middle East conflict and oil supply concerns.

item.title: Moderate Rainfall Forecast for Guwahati; Flash Flood Warning Issued for Key Areas
item.description: The IMD has forecast moderate rainfall across Guwahati and its adjoining areas from March 24 to March 26, raising concerns about possible waterlogging and flash floods in several low-lying localities.
